Nordic- Shamanic- Native American - Celtic inspired music

Welcome to our Youtube channel!. 

Munknörr is an independent project of Shamanic - Nordic - Celtic music with various elements. In our compositions we seek for a pagan sound with a dark and mystic vibe, we try to get closer to a natural dark primitive sound , and we also try to make people feel in contact with ancient times.
Join the journey to ancient times!!

Feel free to comment and interact, for me its important to know what you think
